# mergegateway_project (Resource)

Manages a Merge Gateway project, including its budget and routing policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A project with a monthly budget and the organization's default routing.
resource "mergegateway_project" "support_bot" {
  name        = "Support bot"
  description = "Answers customer support tickets"

  budget_config = {
    amount              = 500
    period              = "monthly"
    enforcement_mode    = "hard_limit"
    alert_thresholds    = [50, 80, 100]
    notification_emails = ["ai-platform@example.com"]
  }
}

# A project with its own routing policy: try gpt-4o first, then gpt-4o-mini.
resource "mergegateway_project" "batch_jobs" {
  name = "Batch jobs"

  routing_policy = {
    strategy = "PRIORITY"
    priority_order = [
      { model = "openai/gpt-4o", priority = 1 },
      { model = "openai/gpt-4o-mini", priority = 2 },
    ]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The project's name.

### Optional

- `budget_config` (Attributes) The project's spending budget. Remove the block to remove the budget. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--budget_config))
- `description` (String) A description of the project. Leave it out for none.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the project is active. Defaults to `true`.
- `routing_policy` (Attributes) The project's own routing policy. Leave it out to route with the organization's default policy; removing it deletes the project's policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routing_policy))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the project was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) The project's ID.
- `organization_id` (String) The ID of the organization that owns the project.
- `slug` (String) Derived from the name when the project is created. It does not change when the project is renamed.
- `updated_at` (String) When the project was last changed (RFC 3339).
- `uses_organization_default_routing` (Boolean) Whether the project routes with the organization's default policy, that is, `routing_policy` is not set.

<a id="nestedatt--budget_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `budget_config`

Required:

- `amount` (Number) Budget amount in USD. Must be greater than 0.
- `enforcement_mode` (String) `soft_limit` only alerts when the budget is reached; `hard_limit` also blocks requests.
- `period` (String) The budget period: `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`, `quarterly` or `yearly`.

Optional:

- `alert_thresholds` (Set of Number) Percentages of the budget that trigger an alert, such as `[50, 80, 90]`. Defaults to none.
- `notification_emails` (Set of String) Addresses emailed when an alert threshold is crossed, at most 20. Addresses are compared ignoring case, so don't list one twice in different cases. Defaults to none.
- `notify_org_admins` (Boolean) Also email every organization admin when an alert threshold is crossed. Defaults to `true`.


<a id="nestedatt--routing_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routing_policy`

Required:

- `strategy` (String) `PRIORITY` tries the models in `priority_order`; `INTELLIGENT` picks among `allowed_models` along `axis`.

Optional:

- `allowed_models` (List of String) `INTELLIGENT` only. The models to choose from, each listed once. Every model must have a capability tier: the API drops models without one, and the provider reports that as an error.
- `axis` (String) `INTELLIGENT` only. What to optimize for: `COST`, `PERFORMANCE` or `CAPABILITY`. Defaults to `COST`.
- `priority_order` (Attributes Set) `PRIORITY` only. The models to try, each listed once; lower `priority` is tried first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routing_policy--priority_order))

Read-Only:

- `allowed_providers` (List of String) `INTELLIGENT` only. The providers of `allowed_models`, sorted.
- `created_at` (String) When the routing policy was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) The routing policy's ID.
- `model` (String) The value to send as `model` in a request to route with this policy, such as `@alias/<slug>`.
- `modified_at` (String) When the routing policy was last changed (RFC 3339).
- `slug` (String) The routing policy's handle, when it has one.

<a id="nestedatt--routing_policy--priority_order"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routing_policy.priority_order`

Required:

- `model` (String) The model.
- `priority` (Number) The model's priority.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a project by its ID.
terraform import mergegateway_project.support_bot 6f1c1f5e-8a8b-4c43-9a0e-3f0f6d0c8b11
```
